items.title: HumCareADL: A diverse multimodal dataset and HyMCL-Net for robust human activity recognition
items.abstract: Earlier wearable-IMU activity datasets suffer from narrow demographics, low sampling rates and small cohorts. HumCareADL is a diverse multimodal dataset that spans age groups and contexts. HyMCL-Net is a hybrid multi-branch CNN-LSTM in which convolutions learn spatial features and LSTMs learn temporal dependencies.
